main.description: Unsend (decision J1): redact the caller's own sender copies of one message in a conversation's thread records. Every matching item of the caller keeps its batch, server order, messageId, timestamp, mekId and senderTransportPubkey; its signedEncMessage becomes empty and it gains the author's signed redaction (defs#redaction, with redactedAt set by the server). Author only: items written by other DIDs are never touched, even under a reused messageId ([CB-31]). Every attachment reference to the message is invalidated. Current membership is not required. Thread endpoint on the conversation's sequencer DS; a device homed elsewhere is relayed (labyrinthRelay). Idempotent: an unknown or already-redacted id counts zero. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.

redaction.description: The author's signed request (transportPubkey, sig); redactedAt is set by the server and must be absent.

redacted.description: How many stored items this call redacted.
